description: Numerical substitution for an original free name is correct even when the formula and replacement term also contain auxiliary names.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.mixed_substitution_correct.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) {n : ℕ} (a : L.BoundedFormula (ℕ ⊕ ℕ) n)
  (i : ℕ) (t : L.Term (ℕ ⊕ ℕ)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.substitute S n
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.mixedCode S a) i
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.termCode S
        (Sum.elim Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.freeName
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.auxName)
        t) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.mixedCode S
      (a.subst fun j => if j = Sum.inl i then t else FirstOrder.Language.var j)
